svg.text: Last summer I worked as a (1) ______ in a children's hospital. I did not get
paid, but I enjoyed helping people. My (2) ______ was to read stories to the
children and play games with them. Every morning I had to (3) ______ up at
six to get there by seven. The nurses were very kind and always ready to (4)
______ me good advice. I am very (5) ______ of what I have done, and I am
going to do it again next year. In my opinion, young people should do more
